items.question: Do customers need to install an app?
items.answer: No. Customers simply scan the QR code using their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser.

items.question: Can I update my menu anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You can edit items, prices, photos, and availability at any time from your dashboard.

items.question: Can each table have its own QR code?
items.answer: Yes. You can generate QR codes for individual tables so orders can be associated more accurately.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most restaurants can get started in minutes by creating an account, adding menu items, and generating QR codes.

items.question: Is this suitable for small restaurants and cafes?
items.answer: Yes. ScanEat is ideal for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, and small food businesses that want a simple digital menu workflow.
